# CC0 M4A1 source asset

`assets/source_models/m4a1_cc0/M4A1.fbx` and its associated PBR textures are
the CC0 M4A1 Assault Rifle source published by `nisu` through OpenGameArt.
The project keeps the unmodified downloaded source separately from the
normalized `operative_carbine_tp` build output so the conversion is auditable.
[src: url: https://opengameart.org/content/m4a1-assault-rifle]

The asset page identifies the work as Public Domain (CC0).  Attribution is not
required by CC0; this note records provenance and the source used by
`tools/blender/import_cc0_m4a1_carbine.py`.
[src: url: https://opengameart.org/content/m4a1-assault-rifle]
